newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM says Northwest stake sale an option.
newsitem.headline: KLM says Northwest stake sale an option.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Wednesday that the sale of its shares in Northwest Airlines was one of the options open to it in resolving the partners' long-running dispute over KLM's Northwest holding.
"One of the options is a possible sale of shares to Northwest," KLM spokesman Peter Wellhuener said.
But Wellhuener declined to comment on the likelihood of a Northwest sale going ahead, saying only "It is an option...how important (an option) it is, we will not comment."

He said talks at management level to resolve the dispute over KLM's 19 percent Northwest stake were continuing, and KLM would not comment on their progress. Northwest has accused KLM of trying to extend its influence over it.

Dutch De Telegraaf newspaper said in a front-page article on Wednesday KLM was mulling the sale of its Northwest stake to further the lucrative operational alliance between the two, which until now has been based on short-term contracts.
